items.title: DeepSeek-V3 ends promotional pricing, updates API service rates
items.raw_content: DeepSeek-V3's 45-day promotional pricing period for its API service will end on Feb. 8, with new pricing set to take effect on Feb. 9. Under the updated
items.title_zh: DeepSeek-V3 结束优惠定价，调整 API 服务价格
items.summary: DeepSeek-V3's 45-day promotional pricing period for its API service ended on February 8, with new pricing taking effect on February 9.

items.title: Multiple Russian Threat Actors Targeting Microsoft Device Code Authentication
items.raw_content: Starting in mid-January 2025, Volexity identified several social-engineering and spear-phishing campaigns by Russian threat actors aimed at compromising Microsoft 365 (M365) accounts. These attack campaigns were highly targeted and carried out in a variety of ways. The majority of these attacks originated via spear-phishing emails with different themes. In one case, the eventual breach began with highly tailored outreach via Signal.Through its investigations, Volexity discovered that Russian threat actors were impersonating a variety of individuals
items.title_zh: 多个俄罗斯威胁行为者瞄准 Microsoft 设备代码认证
items.summary: Volexity reported that starting in mid-January 2025, several Russian threat actors ran targeted social-engineering and spear-phishing campaigns to compromise Microsoft 365 accounts, including one case that began with tailored outreach on Signal.

items.title: OpenAI’s first AI chip to tape out at TSMC in first half of the year: report
items.raw_content: To reduce its reliance on NVIDIA and other AI chip suppliers, OpenAI is expected to have its first in-house AI chip taped out at TSMC in the first half of
items.title_zh: 报道：OpenAI 首款 AI 芯片将于上半年在台积电流片
items.summary: OpenAI is reportedly set to have its first in-house AI chip taped out at TSMC in the first half of the year, part of an effort to reduce its reliance on Nvidia and other AI chip suppliers.

items.title: Xiaomi to invest $4.2 billion in R&D development in 2025
items.raw_content: At Beijing’s Haidian District Economic and Social High-Quality Development Conference yesterday, Xiaomi CEO Lei Jun highlighted the critical role of both
items.title_zh: 小米 2025 年将投入 42 亿美元用于研发
items.summary: At a Beijing development conference, Xiaomi CEO Lei Jun stressed the importance of research and development, with the company set to invest $4.2 billion in R&D in 2025, TechNode reports.

items.title: Vivo announces integration of DeepSeek into its mobile operating system
items.raw_content: Chinese phone brand Vivo said it will integrate the full-powered DeepSeek into its OriginOS mobile operating system, as the company intends to make their
items.title_zh: vivo 宣布将 DeepSeek 集成进手机操作系统
items.summary: Chinese phone brand Vivo said it will integrate the full-powered DeepSeek model into its OriginOS mobile operating system.

items.title: Multiple Russian Threat Actors Targeting Microsoft Device Code Authentication

items.summary: Volexity reported that starting in mid-January 2025, several Russian threat actors ran targeted social-engineering and spear-phishing campaigns to compromise Microsoft 365 accounts, including one case that began with tailored outreach on Signal.

items.title: Advertising Is a Cancer on Society (2019)
items.title_zh: 广告是社会的毒瘤（2019）
items.summary: A 2019 essay sets out the author's detailed argument that advertising is a cancer on modern society.

items.title: Show HN: HTML visualization of a PDF file's internal structure
items.title_zh: Show HN：用 HTML 可视化 PDF 文件的内部结构
items.summary: A Show HN project visualizes a PDF file's internal structure in HTML and adds features such as an info panel, page index, minimap, and inverted index for inspection, debugging, or learning about the format.

items.title: What about K?
items.title_zh: K 语言是什么？
items.summary: An introduction to the k family of concise, vector-oriented programming languages covers its generations, Arthur Whitney's from-scratch design approach, and the newer Shakti-k effort.

items.title: Intel's Battlemage Architecture
items.title_zh: Intel 的 Battlemage 架构
items.summary: A Chips and Cheese article examines Intel's Battlemage architecture, following the earlier Alchemist generation that the piece says gave Intel a foothold in the high-performance graphics segment.

items.title: Ask HN: Former employees' RSUs at risk after startup's IPO
items.title_zh: Ask HN：初创公司上市后，前员工的 RSU 面临风险
items.summary: Former employees of a startup that recently listed on Nasdaq ask Hacker News for advice on an unexpected RSU settlement process, including a required cash tax prepayment before shares are delivered.

items.title: TL;DW: Too Long; Didn't Watch Distill YouTube Videos to the Relevant Information
items.title_zh: TL;DW：把 YouTube 视频浓缩成关键信息
items.summary: TL;DW is presented as a tool for distilling YouTube videos down to the relevant information for viewers who do not want to watch the whole thing.

items.title: Cheap blood test detects pancreatic cancer before it spreads
items.title_zh: 廉价血液检测可在胰腺癌扩散前将其发现
items.summary: Nature reports on a cheap blood test that can detect pancreatic cancer before it spreads, a disease often found only after it has reached other parts of the body.

items.title: Resigning as Asahi Linux project lead
items.title_zh: Asahi Linux 项目负责人宣布卸任
items.summary: The Asahi Linux project lead describes resigning from the leadership role during a period of significant turmoil and burnout, while saying he hoped to recover and later resume contributing to Asahi Linux and the wider Linux community.

items.title: DA, sheriff, who shared woman's nude photos on phone are covered by QI
items.title_zh: 分享女子裸照的检察官和警长受资格豁免保护
items.summary: According to OregonLive, a district attorney and a sheriff who shared a woman's nude photos from her phone are covered by qualified immunity.

items.title: The largest sofa you can move around a corner
items.title_zh: 能绕过拐角搬动的最大沙发
items.summary: A new proof reveals the answer to the decades-old moving sofa problem, highlighting how even the simplest optimization problems can have counterintuitive answers, Quanta Magazine reports.

items.title: Did Semgrep Just Get a Lot More Interesting?
items.title_zh: Semgrep 忽然变得更有意思了吗？
items.summary: A Fly.io blog post highlights Geoffrey Huntley's argument that LLM-driven coding agents like Cursor have something like a 40% success rate at building anything that passes acceptance criteria.

items.title: Schemesh: Fusion between Unix shell and Lisp REPL
items.title_zh: Schemesh：Unix shell 与 Lisp REPL 的融合
items.summary: Schemesh is a project that fuses a Unix shell and a Lisp REPL into one tool.

items.title: Animate Anyone 2: High-Fidelity Character Image Animation
items.title_zh: Animate Anyone 2：高保真角色图像动画
items.summary: Animate Anyone 2 is presented as a method for high-fidelity character image animation that incorporates environment affordance.

items.title: IPv6 Is Hard
items.title_zh: IPv6 很难
items.summary: A blog post argues that IPv6 is not so much hard as different, using an example where a host resolves over IPv4 but fails to connect over IPv6.

items.title: “A calculator app? Anyone could make that”
items.title_zh: “计算器 App？谁都能做”
items.summary: A blog post pushes back on the claim that a calculator app is trivial to build, discussing what such an app actually involves.

items.title: Learning fast and accurate absolute pitch judgment in adulthood
items.title_zh: 成年后也能快速学会准确的绝对音高判断
items.summary: An eight-week online training program tested whether adults can learn absolute pitch; twelve musicians averaged 21.4 hours across 15,327 trials and learned to name an average of 7.08 pitches by the end of the training.

items.title: Deepseek R1 Distill 8B Q40 on 4 x Raspberry Pi 5
items.title_zh: 在 4 台 Raspberry Pi 5 上运行 Deepseek R1 Distill 8B Q40
items.summary: A distributed-llama discussion reports benchmark throughput for the DeepSeek R1 Distill Llama 8B Q40 model on clusters of two and four Raspberry Pi 5 8GB boards, with the four-board setup reaching 11.68 tokens per second.

items.title: DeepSeek-V3 ends promotional pricing, updates API service rates
items.title_zh: DeepSeek-V3 结束优惠定价，调整 API 服务价格
items.summary: DeepSeek-V3's 45-day promotional pricing period for its API service ended on February 8, with new pricing taking effect on February 9.

items.title_zh: vivo 宣布将 DeepSeek 集成进手机操作系统
items.summary: Chinese phone brand Vivo said it will integrate the full-powered DeepSeek model into its OriginOS mobile operating system.

items.title: China’s Xpeng Motors said to launch its own car accident insurance for assisted driving systems
items.title_zh: 小鹏汽车据称将为辅助驾驶系统推出自有车险
items.summary: Xpeng Motors will soon begin selling its own insurance products, custom-designed with a major insurer to better account for damages, according to the report.

items.title: BYD says its $10,000 EV can drive automatically without intervention
items.title_zh: 比亚迪称其 1 万美元电动车可无需人工干预自动行驶
items.summary: BYD says its $10,000 electric vehicle can drive automatically without human intervention, and analysts at Chinese brokerage Citic said the company's autonomous-driving progress has exceeded their expectations.

items.title: China’s CATL files for secondary listing in Hong Kong to fund expansion
items.title_zh: 宁德时代申请在香港二次上市，为扩产融资
items.summary: Shenzhen-listed battery giant CATL has applied for a Hong Kong secondary listing and plans to use the proceeds to fund construction of new 100 gigawatt-hour capacity.

items.title: ByteDance unveils UltraMem architecture to reduce large model inference costs by up to 83%
items.title_zh: 字节跳动发布 UltraMem 架构，大模型推理成本最高可降 83%
items.summary: ByteDance's Doubao large model team introduced UltraMem, a new architecture designed to address high memory-access issues in large-model inference; the report says it can cut inference costs by up to 83%.

items.title: Apple to restore TikTok on US App Store after Attorney General letter
items.title_zh: 在美国司法部长致信后，苹果将在美国 App Store 恢复 TikTok
items.summary: Apple will restore TikTok to the US App Store on Thursday after a letter from US Attorney General Pam Bondi, Bloomberg reported.

items.title: AgentDeskAI/browser-tools-mcp
items.title_zh: AgentDeskAI/browser-tools-mcp：在 Cursor 等 IDE 中监控浏览器日志
items.summary: browser-tools-mcp lets developers monitor browser logs directly from Cursor and other MCP-compatible IDEs; the project is written in TypeScript.

items.title: MemeMeow-Studio/MemeMeow
items.title_zh: MemeMeow-Studio/MemeMeow：用自然语言检索表情包
items.summary: MemeMeow is a natural-language meme search tool that uses an agent to automatically annotate meme meanings, letting users describe a scene or mood to find a suitable meme. It is written in Python.

items.title: StrayMeteor3337/WechatRealFriends
items.title_zh: StrayMeteor3337/WechatRealFriends：一键检测微信好友关系
items.summary: A JavaScript tool built on the WeChat iPad protocol that checks friend relationships in one click, showing whether contacts have quietly deleted or blocked the user.

items.title: ML-GSAI/LLaDA
items.title_zh: ML-GSAI/LLaDA：大语言扩散模型的官方实现
items.summary: The official PyTorch implementation of the paper "Large Language Diffusion Models".

items.title: Acmesec/theAIMythbook
items.title_zh: Acmesec/theAIMythbook：AI 迷思录（应用与安全指南）
items.summary: TheAIMythbook is a Chinese-language repository described as a guide to AI applications and security, titled "Ai Myth Book".

items.title: alpha-liu-01/SpeedyNote
items.title_zh: alpha-liu-01/SpeedyNote
items.summary: SpeedyNote is a lightweight C++ note-taking app focused on performance, with support for importing PDFs.

items.title: Arindam200/awesome-ai-apps
items.title_zh: Arindam200/awesome-ai-apps
items.summary: A collection of projects illustrating RAG, agents, workflows and other AI use cases, written in Python.

items.title: tailark/blocks
items.title_zh: tailark/blocks
items.summary: A set of Shadcn-based marketing blocks for building page sections, written in TypeScript.

items.title: AmanVarshney01/create-better-t-stack
items.title_zh: AmanVarshney01/create-better-t-stack：端到端类型安全的 TypeScript 脚手架 CLI
items.summary: create-better-t-stack is a modern CLI tool for scaffolding end-to-end type-safe TypeScript projects with best practices and customizable configurations.

items.title: negokaz/excel-mcp-server
items.title_zh: negokaz/excel-mcp-server
items.summary: A Model Context Protocol server that reads and writes Microsoft Excel data, implemented in Go.

items.title: Fundamental Principles of Linguistic Structure are Not Represented by o3
items.title_zh: o3 未能表征语言结构的根本原则
items.summary: Researchers evaluated OpenAI's o3-mini-high and found that while it passes some surface-level linguistic tests, it fails to generalize basic phrase structure rules and other compositional tasks, suggesting deep learning may be hitting a wall on compositionality.

items.title: Game-Of-Goals: Using adversarial games to achieve strategic resilience
items.title_zh: Game-Of-Goals：用对抗性博弈实现战略韧性
items.summary: The paper treats strategic plans as goal trees contested by maximally adversarial competitor agents and applies game-tree search to choose execution strategies that leave adversaries fewer options.

items.title: Cardiverse: Harnessing LLMs for Novel Card Game Prototyping
items.title_zh: Cardiverse：利用 LLM 进行新颖卡牌游戏原型设计
items.summary: Cardiverse is an automated card game prototyping framework that uses graph-based indexing to generate novel game variations, LLM-driven code generation validated against gameplay records, and an ensemble of self-play-optimized heuristic functions for gameplay AI.

items.title: Learning Effective Dynamics across Spatio-Temporal Scales of Complex Flows
items.title_zh: 跨时空尺度学习复杂流动的有效动力学
items.summary: The authors introduce Graph-LED, a framework that combines graph neural networks with an attention-based autoregressive model to learn the effective dynamics of complex fluid flows from limited simulation data. Tests including flow past a cylinder and over a backward-facing step show robust spatio-temporal forecasting.

items.title: AgentGuard: Repurposing Agentic Orchestrator for Safety Evaluation of Tool Orchestration
items.title_zh: AgentGuard：复用智能体编排器评估工具调用安全性
items.summary: AgentGuard is a framework that autonomously discovers and validates unsafe tool-use workflows and then generates safety constraints to confine agent behavior. It draws on the LLM orchestrator's own knowledge of tool functions, workflow generation and execution privileges across four phases, and outputs an evaluation report with unsafe workflows, test cases and validated constraints.

items.title: An Open-Source Web-Based Tool for Evaluating Open-Source Large Language Models Leveraging Information Retrieval from Custom Documents
items.title_zh: 利用自定义文档检索评估开源大语言模型的开源网页工具
items.summary: The paper presents an open-source web tool for evaluating open-source LLMs on document-grounded dialogue and finds that larger models aligned better when the user's speech act was included in the query, while smaller models showed mixed results.

items.title: Smoothing Out Hallucinations: Mitigating LLM Hallucination with Smoothed Knowledge Distillation
items.title_zh: 抚平幻觉：用平滑知识蒸馏缓解大模型幻觉
items.summary: The authors apply knowledge distillation with smoothed soft labels during supervised fine-tuning and report reduced hallucination on summarization benchmarks while general NLP performance is preserved.

items.title: The Geometry of Prompting: Unveiling Distinct Mechanisms of Task Adaptation in Language Models
items.title_zh: 提示的几何学：揭示语言模型任务适应的不同机制
items.summary: Using a framework grounded in statistical physics, the authors examine how different prompting methods reshape representations in decoder-only language models. They find that techniques with similar performance rely on distinct mechanisms, highlight the role of input samples and label semantics in few-shot in-context learning, and show evidence of task interactions at the representation level.
